detail.title: Refining Path Dependence and Value Divergence Research
detail.summary: Interpretation of recent inconclusive experimental results (exp-divergent-values-test-134) regarding value divergence in simulated intelligences, and planning a parameter sensitivity test (exp-divergent-values-test-135) to determine if divergence scales with system coupling.
